read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved. No stale derived state inferred. Fresh MISSION_STATE is authoritative for formal baseline; exact-current executable v1/v2/v2.1 files are authoritative for this review.

agreements: v2.1 separates verified_experience_delta from operational_progress_delta at the output boundary.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only in the current v2.1 path.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/wait/scheduler wake remain zero Experience in inherited v2 semantics.
Anti-thrash cannot block an inherited safety/recovery downshift because the hold only applies when selected_n > current_n.
v2.1 keeps formal_mutation_allowed=false and therefore has no direct formal mutation authority.
The v2.1 contract correctly marks speedup as NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and names operational metrics rather than commit count or awake time.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are free caller inputs rather than values derived from a trusted freshness/authority envelope. The executable has no timestamp, TTL, source fingerprint, authority snapshot hash, replay protection, or provider identity check.
disagreements.required_change: For live/adoptable mode derive freshness/conflict inside a trusted host boundary from a SecretarySignalEnvelope bound to signal hash, source identity, issued/observed time, freshness-policy hash, exact fresh authority snapshot hash and replay-resistant acceptance state.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are annotated bool but never strictly validated. Non-empty strings such as 'false' are truthy and can alter secretary routing.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool freshness/conflict values fail-closed before any secretary routing; strict typing does not replace trusted freshness/authority binding.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience credit is controlled by event_kind plus a free verification flag. No exact evidence hash, independent verifier identity/role, verification receipt, mission/step binding, installation/workspace binding, revocation, or freshness is checked.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a structured verifier receipt bound to exact canonical event/evidence bytes, verifier identity/role, policy, mission/step, installation/workspace identity, acceptance state and revocation/freshness.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events() and select_gear_v2_1() apply Python bool(...) to verification flags; strings such as 'false' or '0', lists and mappings become True and can create verified Experience credit.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool verification values fail-closed before credit calculation and require evidence-bound verifier receipt.

disagreements.finding: Experience ledger dedupe keys only on caller-provided event_id. The same underlying event/evidence can be replayed under arbitrarily many new event_ids and credited repeatedly.
disagreements.required_change: Deduplicate on canonical event/evidence lineage identity and verifier receipt identity; event_id may remain an index but cannot be uniqueness authority.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events() creates seen=set() inside each invocation. Duplicate event_id suppression therefore exists only inside one call. Re-reading the identical durable event in a later invocation, process restart, window restart or replay batch can receive verified/operational credit again even with the same event_id. Current tests cover two duplicates in one list but not cross-call or restart replay.
disagreements.required_change: Adoptable mode requires a durable replay-resistant accepted-event/accepted-evidence registry outside transient process memory, bound to installation/workspace identity and canonical evidence/verifier receipt identity. Cross-run replay of the same accepted event/evidence must be exactly-once or fail closed; rollback/restart semantics require an external or monotonic trusted anchor.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is a free caller-supplied behavioral control. A forged low value can bypass anti-thrash entirely; a forged high value can suppress safe nonessential upshifts. The controller does not derive the ratio from an authenticated shift ledger/window, so anti-thrash behavior itself is not evidence-bound.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate inside the trusted runtime from a canonical append-only shift ledger plus versioned observation-window policy. Bind numerator, denominator, window bounds, sample count, source/runtime identity and policy hash; caller-supplied ratio is diagnostic-only or rejected in adoptable mode.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio>=0.50 has no sample count, observation window, denominator, confidence bound, or provenance. A 1/1 sample is indistinguishable from a stable high-rate regime.
disagreements.required_change: Require sufficient-support metadata and release/cooldown semantics. Numeric thresholds and minimum sample sizes remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: The hold can keep current_gear indefinitely whenever shift rate remains high. Safety downshifts are preserved, but required safe upshifts can be delayed with no maximum hold, confidence decay, recovery bound, or service-level non-regression test.
disagreements.required_change: Add bounded hold/release semantics and paired performance tests proving cycle latency, verified closure throughput and recovery latency do not regress materially while safety behavior is preserved.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently only changes a reason string. It has no denominator/window/independent derivation and must not later become an upshift reinforcement signal without causal controls.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from verified closures over a precommitted denominator/window; any behavioral use requires ablation and anti-self-reinforcement tests.

disagreements.finding: Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational weight 1 are engineering heuristics. Equal sums from different event mixes are not calibrated equivalence of capability, truth, trust or personality growth.
disagreements.required_change: Explicitly prohibit aggregate score from serving as capability truth, trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold without separate calibration. All weights remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: The contract names appropriate speed metrics but there is no executable paired-baseline protocol, matched workload, precommit, uncertainty estimate, observation horizon, or non-inferiority rule yet.
disagreements.required_change: Require matched baseline/candidate runs using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with equal-or-better verification/risk quality. Commit count, wake count and awake time are forbidden speed evidence.

statistical_risks: recent_shift_rate_ratio lacks authenticated numerator/denominator/window provenance, so both anti-thrash activation and bypass can be caller-induced.
recent_shift_rate_ratio lacks sample-size semantics and is vulnerable to small-n false positives.
verified_progress_density lacks denominator/window/independence semantics and may suffer selection bias or become self-reinforcing if later connected to routing.
Anti-thrash can mechanically improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle latency, recovery latency or verified closures.

A transient in-process seen set can make one batch look deduplicated while repeated polling/restart/replay still accumulates the same durable event across runs, creating severe longitudinal inflation bias.
Credit weights 5/4/3 are ordinal heuristics rather than interval-scale capability measurements.
Speed comparison without matched workloads is confounded by task mix, incident rate, verifier availability, route complexity and runtime conditions.
Operational defect count is not monotonic quality: more ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND can indicate a worse system rather than more capability.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE signal with caller-forged secretary_signal_fresh=true must fail closed absent a trusted freshness envelope.
GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-002: secretary signal conflicting with a newer authority snapshot must be ignored even if caller supplies authority_conflict=false.
GB21-FRESHNESS-CLOCK-003: timestamp rollback/forward jump, expired TTL and replayed secretary envelope cannot regain freshness.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: 1/1 and 2/3 observations cannot trigger production anti-thrash absent precommitted minimum-support semantics; threshold/sample policy TEST_REQUIRED.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005: transient shift burst followed by stable demand must allow bounded-time safe upshift while cycle latency and verified closure throughput remain non-regressed.
GB21-SAFETY-UPSHIFT-006: a predeclared safe-service upshift cannot be indefinitely suppressed by stale shift-rate history.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1.0 supplied by caller cannot confer routing, Experience, promotion or authority effects.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008: the same canonical evidence replayed under 10,000 distinct event_ids credits exactly once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009: 'false', '0', list, mapping, object and integer verification values must be rejected fail-closed in both direct and ledger paths.
GB21-SECRETARY-BOOL-COERCION-010: secretary_signal_fresh='false' and non-bool authority_conflict/freshness inputs must be rejected rather than interpreted by truthiness.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified event without exact evidence hash and trusted verifier receipt receives zero verified credit.
GB21-CROSS-EVENT-EVIDENCE-012: two event_ids bound to the same canonical evidence/verifier receipt count once; one event_id rebound to different evidence is an identity conflict.

GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND change only operational progress; verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance and formal authority remain byte-identical.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate credit from different event mixes cannot be interpreted as equivalent capability and cannot alone trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015: matched baseline vs candidate workload reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit count/wake duration excluded.
GB21-V1-V2-NONREGRESSION-016: verified v1 baseline and current v2 regression suite remain preserved before any v2.1 adoption claim.

GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017: caller supplies recent_shift_rate_ratio=0 while trusted shift ledger implies high rate, and then supplies 1 while ledger implies low rate; adoptable controller must ignore/reject caller ratio and deterministically derive the same value from canonical ledger+window policy.

GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018: call aggregate_experience_events([{same verified event e1}]) repeatedly across 1,000 fresh invocations/process restarts; total accepted verified credit must remain exactly one canonical credit, not 1,000x.

GB21-ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019: after accepting event/evidence e1, roll back subject/runtime workspace and replay e1; accepted-event registry outside rollback domain must still reject re-credit. If registry and local state roll back together, trusted monotonic anchor must detect the rollback.

GB21-POLL-REPLAY-020: repeatedly poll the same durable event source without new evidence; verified/operational counters remain invariant after first acceptance while poll itself remains zero Experience.
release_condition: This review does not claim C PASS and does not modify formal/code state.

Fresh secretary influence must be derived from replay-resistant trusted freshness evidence and exact authority snapshot comparison, not caller booleans; non-bool freshness/conflict values fail closed.
Verification flags must be strict booleans and verified Experience must additionally require exact evidence hash plus trusted independent-verifier/C receipt and identity binding.
Experience dedupe must resist same-event/new-ID replay using canonical evidence lineage identity.
Experience exactly-once must persist across repeated function calls, process/window restart, poll replay and rollback; transient in-process seen sets are insufficient for adoptable mode.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and cannot promote verified Experience, P_base or authority.
Anti-thrash shift rate must be derived from canonical authenticated shift history; caller-supplied recent_shift_rate_ratio cannot be routing authority in adoptable mode.
Anti-thrash requires TEST_REQUIRED window/sample support and bounded recovery/performance non-regression while preserving immediate safety downshift.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and tested against self-reinforcement and selection bias.
5/4/3 weights remain heuristic; total credit cannot be used as capability truth or promotion threshold without independent calibration.

Any speedup claim requires paired matched baseline evidence over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
Formal adoption still requires exact-current regression evidence, adversarial review, Navigator synthesis and the existing A->B->C route.
next_lane: Return to Always-on Runtime / Small-World only when exact authority/endpoint permits; W02 performs no formal mutation.
